boundary.title: Something went wrong
boundary.description: An unexpected error stopped this page from loading.

staleChunk.title: Palmr was updated
staleChunk.description: A newer version of Palmr is available. Reload the page to continue.

message.validation: Some of the information entered isn't valid. Review it and try again.
message.requestRejected: Palmr couldn't process this request. Reload the page and try again.
message.notFound: The item you're looking for doesn't exist or is no longer available.
message.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
message.requestTooLarge: This request is larger than the server allows.
message.requestTimeout: The server took too long to respond. Try again.
message.internal: Palmr ran into an unexpected problem. Try again, and contact your administrator with the request ID if it keeps happening.
message.serviceUnavailable: Palmr is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
message.listingChanged: This list changed while you were browsing. Reload it to continue.
message.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
message.securityCheckFailed: Palmr couldn't verify this request. Reload the page and try again.
message.idempotencyConflict: This request was already submitted with different details. Reload the page and try again.
message.requestInProgress: This request is still being processed. Wait a moment before trying again.
message.batchTooLarge: Too many items were selected at once. Select fewer items and try again.
message.emailUnavailable: E-mail isn't configured on this instance, so this action isn't available. Contact your administrator.
message.setupCompleted: This Palmr instance has already been set up.
message.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
message.invalidCredentials: Incorrect sign-in details. Check them and try again.
message.accountLocked: Sign-in is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Try again later.
message.passwordLoginDisabled: Password sign-in is disabled on this instance.
message.passwordChangeRequired: You need to set a new password before continuing.
message.twoFactorEnrollmentRequired: This instance requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue.
message.sessionNotFound: This session no longer exists. It may already have been signed out.
message.passwordPolicy: The password doesn't meet this instance's requirements.
message.emailTaken: This e-mail address is already in use.
message.usernameTaken: This username is already in use.
message.lastAdminProtected: Palmr must keep at least one active administrator.
message.userHasNoLocalAuth: This account has no local password to reset.
message.emailVerificationNotPending: This user has no pending e-mail change to resend.
message.serverBusy: Palmr is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
message.fileNameConflict: Palmr couldn't find a free name for this item. Choose a different name and try again.
message.nameInvalid: This name isn't valid. It can't be empty, too long, or contain slashes or control characters.
message.folderDepthExceeded: Folders can be nested at most 64 levels deep. Choose a shallower location.
message.rangeNotSatisfiable: The requested part of the file isn't available. Start the download again.
message.storageUnavailable: File storage is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
message.storageFull: The server's storage is full. Contact your administrator.
message.storageProviderMismatch: This file is stored in a location the server isn't configured to use. Contact your administrator.
message.storageSizeMismatch: The stored file didn't match the expected size and was discarded. Upload it again.
message.settingValueInvalid: This setting value isn't valid. Review it and try again.
message.settingBelowFloor: This value is below the minimum allowed for this setting.
message.smtpTestFailed: The SMTP test failed. Check the connection details and try again.
message.providerDisabled: This identity provider is turned off.
message.providerSlugTaken: An identity provider with this slug already exists. Choose a different slug.
message.providerDiscoveryFailed: Palmr couldn't read the provider's OpenID Connect configuration. Check the issuer URL and try again.
message.providerValidationFailed: The provider checks failed. Review the failing checks and try again.
message.providerHasLinks: This identity provider still has linked identities. Remove those links or the affected accounts first, then delete it.
message.providerIdTokenInvalid: Palmr couldn't verify the provider's sign-in response. Try again.
message.providerUserinfoFailed: Palmr couldn't read your profile from the provider. Try again in a moment.
message.providerSubjectMissing: The provider didn't return a usable account identifier. Contact your administrator.
message.providerStateInvalid: This sign-in attempt expired or was already used. Start again from the sign-in page.
message.providerAuthDenied: The identity provider denied the sign-in request.
message.providerCodeExchangeFailed: Palmr couldn't complete the sign-in with the provider. Try again in a moment.
message.providerEmailUnverified: The provider didn't confirm your e-mail address, so Palmr can't use it to sign you in. Verify it with the provider, or sign in with your Palmr credentials and link the provider from Settings.
message.providerAutoProvisionDisabled: No Palmr account matches this identity and automatic account creation is turned off. Contact your administrator, or sign in with your Palmr credentials and link the provider from Settings.
message.providerIdentityAlreadyLinked: This identity is already linked to an account, or your account already has an identity from this provider.
message.authAccountInactive: Your Palmr account is deactivated. Contact your administrator.
message.authExternalAmbiguousIdentity: This identity matches more than one account, so sign-in was stopped. Contact your administrator.
message.authExternalUsernameUnavailable: Palmr couldn't create a username for your account. Contact your administrator.
message.providerLinkNotFound: That linked identity no longer exists. Refresh the list and try again.
message.identityLinkLastLoginPath: This is the only way to sign in to this account, so it can't be removed. Link another provider first.
message.passwordLoginDisableUnsafe: This change would leave no safe administrator sign-in path while password sign-in is off, so it was refused.
message.noValidatedProvider: No enabled sign-in provider has been tested successfully yet, so password sign-in can't be turned off. Test a provider first.
message.twoFactorCodeInvalid: The verification code is incorrect. Check your authenticator app and try again.
message.twoFactorCodeReplayed: This code was already used. Wait for your authenticator app to show a new code.
message.twoFactorAlreadyEnabled: Two-factor authentication is already turned on for your account.
message.twoFactorNotEnabled: Two-factor authentication isn't turned on for your account.
message.twoFactorRequiredByPolicy: This instance requires two-factor authentication, so it can't be turned off.
message.twoFactorEnrollmentExpired: This two-factor setup expired. Start the setup again.
message.twoFactorChallengeExpired: This sign-in attempt expired. Sign in again with your password.
message.backupCodeInvalid: This backup code is incorrect or was already used.
message.trustedDeviceDisabled: Remembering devices is turned off on this instance. Sign in without remembering this device.
message.trustedDeviceNotFound: This trusted device no longer exists. It may already have been removed.
message.resetLinkInvalid: This password reset link isn't valid. Request a new one.
message.resetLinkExpired: This password reset link has expired. Request a new one.
message.resetLinkUsed: This password reset link was already used. Request a new one if you still need to reset your password.
message.emailVerificationInvalid: This e-mail verification link isn't valid. Ask an administrator to send a new one.
message.emailVerificationExpired: This e-mail verification link has expired. Ask an administrator to send a new one.
message.inviteNotFound: This invite link isn't valid. Ask an administrator for a new one.
message.inviteExpired: This invite has expired. Ask an administrator to send a new one.
message.inviteUsed: This invite was already used. Sign in instead, or ask an administrator for a new invite.
message.inviteRevoked: This invite was withdrawn by an administrator. Ask for a new one if you still need access.
message.offline: You appear to be offline. Palmr will retry when the connection returns.
message.networkError: The connection to the server was lost. Check your connection and try again.
message.proxyBodyLimit: A proxy in front of Palmr rejected the request as too large. Ask your administrator to raise the proxy's request size limit.
message.proxyBadGateway: Palmr couldn't be reached through the proxy. Try again in a moment.
message.proxyTimeout: The proxy timed out waiting for Palmr. Try again in a moment.
message.unexpectedResponse: The server sent a response Palmr didn't expect. Try again, and contact your administrator with the request ID if it keeps happening.
message.unexpected: Palmr couldn't complete this action. If the problem continues, contact your administrator and include the details below.
